restoration_note: The teaching builds an extended correspondence between body and Father: hidden organs ↔ Father in his kingship; two eyes ↔ two ships of light (sun/moon as Radiances); tongue ↔ Jesus the Radiance who reveals every hidden and manifest matter. Most gaps are tightly constrained by recurrent formulae (ⲭⲓ ϣⲟⲁ ⲍⲓ ⲡⲗⲏⲣⲏ 'receive honor in fullness'; ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲍ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'manifest forth'; the existential ⲟⲩⲛ̄ pattern; the ⲡⲡⲣⲓⲉ title). Internal-letter restorations and short structural fills are high confidence. Two genuinely uncertain points: the heading's 'four -ⲱⲧ' (kept tentatively as 'fathers' per editor, low confidence — four fathers is irregular; could be a different -ⲱⲧ word), and the 8-char gap {3} after ⲛ̄ⲉⲩ- which I tentatively read as 'each other' (the body and Father being likeness of one another). The substantial gap {22} continues the soul-affliction parallel ('they afflicting her, she being…').
